시편 37:1.content: A Psalm of David. Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

시편 37:2.content: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

시편 37:3.content: Trust in the Lord, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

시편 37:4.content: Delight thyself also in the Lord; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

시편 37:5.content: Commit thy way unto the Lord; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

시편 37:6.content: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

시편 37:7.content: Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

시편 37:8.content: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

시편 37:9.content: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.

시편 37:10.content: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.

시편 37:11.content: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

시편 37:12.content: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

시편 37:13.content: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

시편 37:14.content: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

시편 37:15.content: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

시편 37:16.content: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.

시편 37:17.content: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the Lord upholdeth the righteous.

시편 37:18.content: The Lord knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

시편 37:19.content: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

시편 37:20.content: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the Lord shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

시편 37:21.content: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

시편 37:22.content: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.

시편 37:23.content: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord: and he delighteth in his way.

시편 37:24.content: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholdeth him with his hand.

시편 37:25.content: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

시편 37:26.content: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

시편 37:27.content: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

시편 37:28.content: For the Lord loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

시편 37:29.content: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

시편 37:30.content: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

시편 37:31.content: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

시편 37:32.content: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

시편 37:33.content: The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

시편 37:34.content: Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

시편 37:35.content: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

시편 37:36.content: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

시편 37:37.content: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

시편 37:38.content: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

시편 37:39.content: But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

시편 37:40.content: And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
